Expression heatmap of normalized RNA-seq data

rna_heatmap.Rd

Generates a clustered heatmap from normalized expression data, allowing flexible gene selection based on differential expression results, variance, or user-defined gene sets.

Usage

rna_heatmap(
  project,
  group_col = "Group",
  top_n = 100,
  genes = NULL,
  use_variance = FALSE,
  zscore = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  group_colors = NULL,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_regulation = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  save = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

group_col

Character. Column name in metadata defining sample groups for column annotation (default: "Group").

top_n

Integer. Number of genes to include (default: 100).

genes

Character vector. User-defined gene identifiers to include in the heatmap. Overrides other selection methods if provided.

use_variance

Logical. If TRUE, selects the top top_n most variable genes across samples (default: FALSE).

zscore

Logical. If TRUE, applies row-wise z-score normalization prior to plotting (default: TRUE).

cluster_rows

Logical. Whether to cluster genes (rows) (default: TRUE).

cluster_cols

Logical. Whether to cluster samples (columns) (default: TRUE).

group_colors

Character. Vector or named list for group colors.

show_rownames

Logical. Whether to display gene names (default: FALSE).

show_colnames

Logical. Whether to display sample names (default: FALSE).

show_regulation

Logical. If TRUE, adds a row annotation indicating up- and down-regulated genes (default: FALSE).

seed

Optional integer used to set the random seed for reproducibility. If NULL, the existing random number generator state is used.

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project (default: TRUE).

Value

Invisibly returns an object of class heatmap_result containing:

genes_used

Character vector of genes included in the heatmap.

heatmap_matrix

Matrix used for plotting (z-scored if applicable).

annotation_col

Data frame with sample group annotations.

comparison

Comparison used (if applicable).

params

List of parameters and metadata.

Details

Gene selection follows a mutually exclusive strategy:

  • use_variance: selects genes with highest variance across samples. When FALSE, selects genes based on differential expression statistics (typically lowest padj or pvalue).

  • genes: uses a user-defined gene set.

If no selection method is provided, the function defaults to using the most recent stored comparison.

Expression values can be optionally standardized (z-score) per gene to highlight relative expression patterns across samples. Values are clipped to the range [-2, 2] to improve visualization stability.

The heatmap is generated using pheatmap, with optional row and column clustering and annotation tracks.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic usage
rna_heatmap(project = my_project)

# Using most variable genes
rna_heatmap(my_project,
            use_variance = TRUE)

# Using a custom gene set
rna_heatmap(my_project,
            genes = c("GeneA", "GeneB", "GeneC"))
} # }
